name: Engine oil quantity
text: Engine oil: 3.3 L (3.5 US qt) for an oil change without the filter, 3.5 L (3.7 US qt) with the filter. Dry engine fill on the high-power engine is 6.7 L (7.1 US qt).

name: Engine oil grade
text: Engine oil: API service SL, ILSAC GF-3, SAE 5W-20.

name: Engine oil pressure
text: Oil pressure reference value: 350 kPa (3.57 kgf/cm2, 50.8 psi) at 3,000 rpm with the oil at 100 °C (212 °F).

name: Manual transmission oil
text: Manual transmission oil: API service GL-4 or GL-5, SAE 75W-90, approx. 1.75 L (1.85 US qt, 1.54 Imp qt). Fill and drain plug torque is 27-48 N·m (2.8-4.9 kgf·m, 20-35 ft·lbf).

name: Differential oil
text: Differential oil: API service GL-5, SAE 90, approx. 1.2-1.4 L (1.3-1.4 US qt, 1.1-1.2 Imp qt). Fill and drain plug torque is 39.2-53.9 N·m (4.00-5.49 kgf·m, 29.0-39.7 ft·lbf).

name: Coolant capacity
text: Cooling system capacity is 8.7 L (9.2 US qt, 7.7 Imp qt).

name: Thermostat and radiator cap
text: Thermostat starts opening at 80-84 °C (176-183 °F) and is fully open at 95 °C (203 °F), with 8.5 mm (0.33 in) or more of lift. The radiator cap valve opening pressure is 73.3-103.3 kPa (10.63-14.98 psi).

name: Brake fluid
text: Brake fluid: SAE J1703, FMVSS 116 DOT-3.

name: Clutch fluid
text: Clutch fluid: SAE J1703, FMVSS 116 DOT-3 (the same as the brake fluid).

name: Tire pressure
text: Tire air pressure: 220 kPa (2.2 kgf/cm2, 32 psi).

name: Wheel nut torque
text: Wheel nut torque: 89-117 N·m (9.0-12.0 kgf·m, 65.0-87.0 ft·lbf) in the suspension technical data. The steering general procedures list 88-118 N·m for the same nuts, so use 89-117 as the safe overlap.

name: Tire and wheel size
text: Tires and wheels: 225/55R16 94V on 16 x 7 1/2JJ wheels, or 225/45R18 91W on 18 x 8JJ wheels. Wheel offset is 50 mm (2.0 in) and the pitch circle diameter is 114.3 mm (4.50 in).

name: Compression pressure
text: Compression pressure: standard 830 kPa (8.5 kgf/cm2, 120 psi) at 250 rpm, minimum 680 kPa (6.9 kgf/cm2, 98.6 psi). The difference between chambers must be within 150 kPa (21.8 psi) and between rotors within 100 kPa (14.5 psi).

name: Idle speed
text: Idle speed is 750-850 rpm with the manual transmission (760-860 rpm for automatic). It cannot be adjusted, and you need the WDS or equivalent to verify it.

name: Spark plugs
text: Spark plugs (NGK): leading side RE7A-L (RE6A-L hot type is available), trailing side RE9B-T. Standard gap 1.15-1.25 mm (0.046-0.049 in); maximum gap 1.5 mm leading side, 1.4 mm trailing side. Tightening torque 12.8-17.7 N·m (114-156 in·lbf).

name: Fuel pressure
text: Fuel line pressure: 375-450 kPa (3.83-4.58 kgf/cm2, 54.4-65.2 psi). After the pump stops, the hold pressure 5 minutes later should be 200 kPa (2.0 kgf/cm2, 29 psi) or more.

name: Front toe-in
text: Front wheel total toe-in, sport suspension (listed for the FE06), unloaded: 1.4±2.8 mm (0.06±0.11 in) measured at the rim inner, or 2 mm (0.08 in) with ±4 mm tolerance at the tire. The standard suspension is 1.2±2.5 mm (0.05±0.09 in).

name: Rear toe-in
text: Rear wheel total toe-in, sport suspension (listed for the FE06), unloaded: 2.1±2.8 mm (0.083±0.110 in) at the rim inner, or 3 mm (0.12 in) with ±4 mm tolerance at the tire. The standard suspension is 1.9±2.5 mm (0.075±0.098 in).

name: A/C refrigerant
text: A/C refrigerant: R-134a, approx. 430 g (15.2 oz). Compressor oil: DENSO OIL8, approx. 60 ml (2.03 fl oz) sealed volume.

name: Brake pad and disc limits
text: Brake limits: minimum pad thickness 2.0 mm (0.079 in), front and rear. Minimum disc thickness 22 mm (0.87 in) front, 16 mm (0.63 in) rear. Disc runout limit 0.05 mm (0.002 in).

name: Brake pedal
text: Brake pedal: height 175 mm (6.89 in) reference value, play 2-5 mm (0.08-0.19 in), and at least 98.6 mm (3.88 in) of clearance to the floor when pressed with 147 N (15.0 kgf, 33 lbf).

name: Clutch pedal
text: Clutch pedal free play: 5-15 mm (0.20-0.59 in).

name: Parking brake
text: Parking brake lever stroke: 1-3 notches when pulled with 98 N (10 kgf, 22 lbf) at a point 50 mm (1.97 in) from the end of the lever.

name: Steering wheel play and effort
text: Steering wheel play: 0-30 mm (0-1.2 in). Steering effort reference value: 5.0 N·m (50 kgf·cm, 44 in·lbf) or less.

name: Battery type
text: The manual lists battery types 50D20L, 55D23L and 75D26L. It does not say which one your car has.
